summary.intent: Clean up the PR for phase 41 (package/app versioning and release cycles) by resolving all review comments, pruning stale worktrees, and tracking deferred items.
summary.outcome: All review threads resolved (Copilot + CodeRabbit), 5 worktrees pruned, deferred item added to 41-CONTEXT.md, and CodeRabbit's pagination concern handled. Session ended with an unstaged edit to 41-CONTEXT.md blocking a branch switch.

repo: Phase 41 covers package/app versioning and release cycles; verification state lives in 41-VERIFICATION.md
The getCommit GitHub API endpoint returns a maximum of 300 files per response — relevant to release preview logic

code.finding: Deferred items section exists here; the 300-file pagination limit on getCommit is already tracked as a deferred item alongside 'PR release preview N+1 API calls'

workflow: CodeRabbit can take 17+ minutes to process a large diff (29 edits in this case); background polling is the right pattern
Worktree cleanup should diff unstaged files against the feature branch before pruning to avoid data loss
GraphQL resolveReviewThread mutation is used to resolve threads; REST is used for replies with in_reply_to as an integer field
Edits made directly to planning files in the main worktree can block branch switches if not committed first

friction: CodeRabbit took 17+ minutes to post its review, requiring multiple background polling rounds
The background task check returned a false 'clean' result before CodeRabbit had actually finished its review
Session ended with 41-CONTEXT.md having unstaged changes in the main worktree, blocking `git switch main`
open_items: Manual labels need to be reapplied after the last commit — noted as not actually fixed with a TODO(deferred) comment
getCommit 300-file pagination limit is deferred — won't be hit in practice but is a known gap in release preview logic
41-CONTEXT.md edits need to be committed or stashed before switching to main
